_description: SECURE 2.0 RMD start age is 75 for anyone born 1960 or later. A born-1960 retiree must NOT have RMDs forced at 73/74 — the engine derives the start age from referenceYear - currentAge, not a hardcoded 73.
_rationale: Single, Florida, currentAge 66, referenceYear 2026 → birth year 1960 → SECURE 2.0 RMD start age 75. $500k Traditional, no income, no spending, 0% growth, 0% inflation. With nothing pulling the account, the balance stays exactly $500k through age 74 and no RMD is forced (rmdRequired = 0 at ages 73 and 74 — the regression guard against the old hardcoded-73 behavior, which would have forced ~$18,868 at 73). At age 75 the first RMD fires on the $500k beginning-of-year balance: 500000 / 24.6 (IRS Uniform Lifetime divisor at 75) = $20,325.20. No spending means the plan never fails → probability 100%.
name: RMD SECURE 2.0 Age 75
